content: प्रशस्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Praise, eulogy, laudation. .²2 Description; <ls>U. 7</ls>. .²3 A panegyric or small poem written in praise of any one ({%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} a patron). .²4 Excellence, eminence. .²5 Benediction. .²6 Guidance, instruction, rule for guidance; as in लेखप्रशस्तिः ‘a form of writing’. .²7 Publicity, advertising; दशाननतिरस्कारप्रशस्तिमिव <ls>Mv. 5. 12</ls>.
